learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish between group, ring, and field structures and illustrate them using modular arithmetic.
Describe the fundamentals of linear algebra and the properties of linear mappings.
Calculate eigenvalues and eigenvectors and diagonalize matrices.
Develop analytic functions into power series.
Reproduce the definition of the Riemann integral, the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, and the Mean Value Theorem of integral calculus.
Understand and apply integration techniques such as substitution, integration by parts, integration via partial fraction decomposition, and power series expansion.
Reproduce and apply fundamental concepts of numerical methods in connection with integration.
Solve first-order differential equations by separation of variables, integrating factors, and variation of parameters.
